candidate: possession-v2.13 = possession-v2.11 (or its variant v2.11g) in which the last step, the v2.11 decoder, is replaced by the fusion rule of the teammate's branch: the second-stage probabilities of v2.11 are averaged with the probabilities of a temporal convolution network (TCN) and decoded by one Viterbi pass. Everything before that step (reader, play blocks, noise gate, goalkeeper team check, broadcast alignment, registration, 0.50 m gate, both model paths and their second stage) is unchanged. The kick-off handling is not part of this validation (see below).

tcn.author: Huseyin Umut Isik (team member)
tcn.description: docs/POSSESSION_TCN.md of that commit: 37 team-symmetric features per frame (features.py), dilated temporal convolution network at 12.5 Hz with three outputs (team 0, team 1, dead), inference in NumPy float64 (infer.py), probabilities averaged over ensemble members and both team orders and rounded to 4 decimals
tcn.training_data_as_documented_by_the_autho: open DFL data (Bassek et al. 2025, CC BY 4.0) only, corrupted by the author's simulator (degrade.py): tcn_dfl6.npz on J03WN1, J03WOH, J03WOY, J03WPY, J03WQQ, J03WR9, three seeds; tcn_dfl5_without_<match>.npz on the five other matches of those six, one seed, same recipe. No Metrica game and not J03WMX in these weights. Not re-trained or checked by us; taken as documented.
tcn.weights_if_selected: tcn_dfl6.npz as committed, with the released v2 bundles; nothing is trained after the decision

fusion_rule_fixed_before_any_score.source: possession/fuse.py of the commit (WEIGHT = 0.5, SWITCH_COST = 6.0), nothing chosen by this plan
steps: v2.11 side: second-stage P(dead) and P(home | alive), rounded to 6 decimals, exactly what the v2.11 decoder is given; on the v2.3 path (measured noise above 0.30 m) they come from the smoothed input and the v2.3 models
three classes: home = (1 - P(dead)) * P(home | alive), away = (1 - P(dead)) * (1 - P(home | alive)), dead = P(dead)
TCN probabilities (12.5 Hz) linearly interpolated to the 25 fps frame grid
arithmetic mean at 25 fps, weight 0.5 each
one Viterbi pass over log(clip(p, 1e-6, 1)) with cost 6 for every state change, per play block; D outside the blocks
the v2.11 decoder (switch 3 or 5, out/in 60, dead bias -0.3) is not used in the fused system
fusion_rule_fixed_before_any_score.tcn_input: the tracking the v2 models see: packed slots, after the goalkeeper team check, with the filled ball when the 0.50 m gate opened; never smoothed (also on the v2.3 path); metres from the pitch centre (our corner-origin coordinates minus half the pitch size), float32, NaN where missing; team 0 = home slots

models_per_match.J03WN1, J03WR9 (DFL): v2.11 side: validation models trained on J03WOH, J03WOY, J03WPY, J03WQQ (cache/models_v2.pkl, stack_v2.pkl, models_v23.pkl, stack_v23.pkl), as in every earlier validation. TCN side: tcn_dfl5_without_<that match>.npz
models_per_match.Metrica games 1, 2 (and 3, reported): the pair as it would be released: v2 bundles models/possession-v2.npz and possession-v23.npz (six DFL matches) through possession.pipeline.predict_labels, and tcn_dfl6.npz. Neither saw a Metrica game. This differs from earlier validations, which used the four-match validation models on Metrica as well.

known_asymmetries: DFL rows: the v2.11 validation models are trained on four matches, the TCN on five (the other validation match included), with one seed instead of the three of tcn_dfl6.npz. Neither side saw the scored match. The released pair would have six matches each.

The TCN was trained on its author's simulator and on tracking as given; here it reads goalkeeper-corrected, slot-packed and (in the fill conditions) broadcast-filled tracking corrupted by our simulator.

decision_rule: All six gates pass: the fusion is selected and integrated as possession-v2.13 (new entry point and manifest; byte copies of the commit's inference modules; tcn_dfl6.npz with the registered SHA-256; v2.11 becomes the next step of the technical ladder). It replaces v2.11 / v2.11g in the delivery only if, before the freeze (14 Nov 2026 23:59 Istanbul), the ported inference runs under Python 3.10 / numpy 1.26.4, the output on the synthetic provided-like bundles is byte-identical across Python 3.10 / numpy 1.26.4 and Python 3.13 / numpy 2.5.3, the full test suite passes, the delivery chain runs OK on the team's computer, and the documents describe the TCN's data and its development history; otherwise v2.11 / v2.11g stays. Any gate fails: v2.11 / v2.11g stays the release and the fusion is recorded as tried and not used. The gates are applied once, to all rows; nothing is re-run with other seeds, weights, mixing weights or switch costs.
reported_alongside: every row; means per source (DFL, Metrica) in every condition; the TCN alone; recall of possessions under 2 s and under 1 s; transition F1 at 12 / 25 frames; numbers of predicted spells; frames changed; noise path and goalkeeper moves per copy
Metrica game 3 and PFF game 3839 after the decision (not gates)
not_part_of_this_validation: Kick-off handling (the frame published in FAQ.md, the Smart Tagging kick-off tag, or neither): it cannot be measured on external data. It is decided by the team separately and described in the documents.
The provided match: not read, not run and not scored by this validation.
limits: The validation matches were used for every earlier selection of v2.x and for the development of the TCN recipe; only the copies are new. This is a validation, not a fresh test.

There is no untouched test for the fused system: J03WMX was used in the TCN's development. The registered final test of v2.11 on J03WMX (never downloaded on our side) would not describe a released v2.13; a J03WMX run of the fusion could only be reported as not fresh.
Corruption, slot packing, camera window and broadcast camera are simulated by us; the provided tracking may differ.
DFL labels are the provider's per-frame flags; Metrica labels are our event-derived proxies.

The fused system drops the v2.11 decoder with its dead-ball bias and entry / exit costs, so the character of the output (number and length of possessions, share of dead ball) changes as a whole, not only where the models disagree.

NumPy matrix products are not guaranteed bit-identical across BLAS builds; the 4-decimal rounding makes a different output unlikely, not impossible. Checked only by the integration tests named in the decision rule.
